patches.rationale: Retain element, table row and cell identities only on explicit extraPickAttrs id requests; default clipboard serialization strips IDs, and extra value cannot overwrite recursive cell content. Author saves opt in.
Allow application-owned operation journals to disable runtime glyph snapshot allocation explicitly with historyMaxRecordCount zero; positive counts retain existing native history.

Search produces UTF-16 offsets while the editor renders grapheme elements. Map folded-text boundaries to runtime elements, reject partial graphemes, preserve trailing text after tables and use the cursor-before-selection range convention.
coverage: Repeated quotations after emoji and combining characters
Complete Unicode selections and partial-grapheme search rejection
Same quotation in different table cells
Case-fold expansion and text after the final table

patches.rationale: Reserve forbidden-in-canonical-text NUL for transient paragraph syntax, preserving literal U+200B Unicode content, search and UTF-16 selection; suppress sentinel glyph rendering.
Toggle explicit pending insertion formatting before preceding glyph formatting so OFF then ON restores styled caret input without modifying surrounding text.
coverage: Bold, italic, underline and strikeout
Initially styled and plain caret targets
Zero through three toggles followed by actual keyboard input
Unchanged surrounding text and formatting

patches.rationale: Route cancelable virtual-keyboard deletion and paragraph/line-break intentions through existing guarded keyboard handlers; mark soft Enter explicitly and preserve heading/list identity.
coverage: Chromium and WebKit emulated mobile profiles
Body/table-cell Unicode edits and exact native undo/redo
Unchanged neighboring cells and header/footer stories
Heading/list soft-break identity
Read-only and composition guards
Physical keyboard deletion executes once without repeated beforeinput mutation
Multiline text/dictation preserves exact literal soft newline
Application beforeinput cancellation remains authoritative

patches.rationale: Restrict opt-in touch selection to range extension; cancellation, lost capture and mode disable abort without a drop or formatting effect, restore the original range/style and release capture.
coverage: Actual Chromium CDP touch end/cancel/disable/lost-capture
Exact content preservation and initial selection restoration on cancellation
Pointer capture release
Ordinary mouse text drag remains supported
Touch during trusted composition cannot retarget a neighboring table cell

patches.rationale: Intersect cursor scrolling geometry with the visible viewport so software keyboard occlusion does not leave the caret hidden behind the layout viewport.
coverage: Chromium and WebKit emulated visual viewport keyboard geometry
Caret remains within visible bounds with its range unchanged
Physical device acceptance explicitly unverified

patches.rationale: Use full row layout for Proser paragraph indentation/spacing/pagination metadata absent from upstream incremental convergence state; preserve the default-disabled experimental option.
